name: AGMO
recent: AGMO 近期完成董事会与委员会成员调整，并于 9 月 22 日召开第五届常年股东大会，所有议案均获通过。公司同时进行股份回购，CEO Tan Aik Keong 在公开市场增持股份。新闻方面，公司与 MyDigital Corp 合作推动 AI 技能提升，并成为 Anthropic Claude 合作伙伴网络中的 Select 层级伙伴。
notable: AGMO 与 MyDigital Corp 合作，推动马来西亚人 AI 技能提升。
AGMO 成为 Anthropic Claude 合作伙伴网络中的 Select 层级伙伴。
公司进行股份回购，并披露 CEO Tan Aik Keong 增持股份。
risks: 公司进行股份回购，可能影响股本结构。
董事会及委员会成员出现多项变动。

recent_en: AGMO recently completed board and committee changes and held its Fifth AGM on 22 Sep 2026, with all resolutions passed. The company has been buying back shares, and CEO Tan Aik Keong acquired shares in the open market. In the news, the company partnered with MyDigital Corp to upskill Malaysians in AI and became a Select tier partner in Anthropic's Claude partner network.
notable_en: AGMO partnered with MyDigital Corp to upskill Malaysians in AI.
AGMO became a Select tier partner in Anthropic's Claude partner network.
The company conducted share buybacks, and CEO Tan Aik Keong acquired shares.
risks_en: The company conducted share buybacks, which may affect its share capital structure.
There were multiple changes in board and committee memberships.
